description: M6 built-in agent (ADR 0014 §4, §11): editor windows and the document host manage provider keys in the OS keychain (values never returned), relay AI requests through Rust (kimo_ai_request / kimo_ai_abort, streamed on kimo://ai-response) and detect, spawn and drive the user's agent CLIs (kimo://cli-output, kimo://cli-exit).
